description: Result codes for checking and installing a release. Every implementation reports these exact codes, so a failure reads the same on a device, in a host app and in PelcoHub. `step` is the step in release-format.md section 7. Codes are never renumbered or reused.

codes.meaning: Every check passed.
The release file isn't a valid release container: wrong entries, wrong order, or over a size limit.
manifest.sig isn't a valid signature file.
No signature is by a key in the keyring.
A signature by a known key doesn't verify over the manifest bytes.
The manifest's format or format_version isn't supported by this reader.
The manifest isn't valid JSON, or breaks the schema or a rule of the format.
The signing key isn't allowed to sign this channel or product, or has expired.
The installer doesn't accept this channel, for example a test release on a unit not set up for testing.
The release is for a different component than the one being updated.
The target unit's hardware isn't in the release's hardware list.
The release may not be installed over the route being used.
A required component is missing, out of range, or its version is unknown.
The same version is already installed and a reinstall wasn't requested.
The release is older than what's installed and the downgrade flag wasn't given.
The installer doesn't know how to install one of the payload types.
The release is encrypted and the installer holds none of its recipient keys.
The content key couldn't be unwrapped with the installer's recipient key.
A payload's stored size doesn't match the manifest.
A payload's stored SHA-256 doesn't match the manifest.
A chunk of an encrypted payload failed authentication.
A decrypted payload's size or SHA-256 doesn't match the manifest.
